title: Adjacency matrix word
statement: Given a Boolean matrix $A$ indexed by pairs of elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, form a Boolean word by listing its entries row by row: first all entries in row $0$ in increasing column order, then those in row $1$, and so on through row $n-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a Boolean matrix indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
